title: Post money received in Slack
summary: When money comes in by link, transfer or a customer's account number, post who paid and how much in a Slack channel.
description: Whenever your payments account reports money received (a payment link, a transfer, or a payment into a customer's own account number), posts the amount and its reference in the Slack channel you choose, so your team sees sales as they happen. The payer's name is left out: Slack is shared with everyone in the channel.

params.name: rail_connection
params.title: Payments account
params.description: Whose payments to post; every connected payments account when left blank.

params.name: slack_connection
params.title: Slack connection
params.description: Your Slack workspace, connected with Add to Slack.

params.name: channel
params.title: Slack channel
params.description: Where the message is posted. For a private channel, invite the Taskiem app to it first.

output.text: ='Received ' + (has(trigger.fields.currency) && trigger.fields.currency != 'NGN' ? trigger.fields.currency + ' ' + string(trigger.fields.amount_kobo / 100) : '₦' + string(trigger.fields.amount_kobo / 100)) + (trigger.event == 'virtual_account.credited' ? ' into a customer account number' : '') + ' (' + (trigger.event == 'virtual_account.credited' ? trigger.fields.credit_id : trigger.fields.payment_id) + ').'
